source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

support.quote: Riktor, Dekker and Phase beat this lane; stay beside your carry and answer their engage instead of throwing Web Lash first.
support.issue: Phase is not in the listed matchups; Narbash is the third losing matchup
support.rewrite: Riktor, Dekker and Narbash beat this lane; stay beside your carry and answer their engage instead of throwing Web Lash first.

support.quote: Riktor, Dekker and Phase beat this lane; let them engage first and answer with Cursed Edge instead of leaping in.
support.issue: Phase is not in the listed matchups; Narbash is the third losing matchup
support.rewrite: Riktor, Dekker and Narbash beat this lane; let them engage first and answer with Cursed Edge instead of leaping in.

midlane.quote: Plant Flame Turret near the wave, roll Oil Spill through the enemy, then ignite it with Molotov so turrets keep firing on them. Once Orion and Wraith Leggings are done, hold Inferno for when they're stuck in the oil next to your turrets.
midlane.issue: igniting the oil does not make turrets fire; wrong cause and effect
midlane.rewrite: Plant Flame Turret near the wave, roll Oil Spill through the enemy, then ignite it with Molotov to burn them while your turrets keep firing. Once Orion and Wraith Leggings are done, hold Inferno for when they're slowed in the oil next to your turrets.

jungle.quote: Throw Judgement of the Heavens to tether them, dash through with Surge of the Heavens to recall the blade, then Light of the Heavens to hit and shield. After Orion and Prophecy, keep the blade energized and teleport in with Fury of the Heavens.
jungle.issue: Fury of the Heavens only teleports to a blade left on the ground; after Surge recalls it there is nothing to teleport to
jungle.rewrite: Throw Judgement of the Heavens to tether them, dash through with Surge of the Heavens to recall the blade, then Light of the Heavens to hit and shield. After Orion and Prophecy, keep the blade energized, and throw it ahead first so Fury of the Heavens teleports you in.

support.quote: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Phase win this lane on our read; stay behind your carry and save Maco Strike! to stop their engage.
support.issue: Phase is not in the matchup list; Narbash is the fourth losing matchup
support.rewrite: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Narbash win this lane on our read; stay behind your carry and save Maco Strike! to stop their engage.

support.quote: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Phase win this lane on our read; don't charge Serenity in the open, stay behind your carry with Alacrity ready.
support.issue: Phase is not in the matchup list; Narbash is the fourth losing matchup
support.rewrite: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Narbash win this lane on our read; don't charge Serenity in the open, stay behind your carry with Alacrity ready.

offlane.quote: Finish minions with Siphon to collect Souls, and trade by landing Subjugate first, then Phantom Rush through them for the fear. After Orion and Timewarp by minute 16, follow every Subjugate with Colossal Blow on whoever is caught.
offlane.issue: Colossal Blow is the ultimate and won't be ready for every Subjugate
offlane.rewrite: Finish minions with Siphon to collect Souls, and trade by landing Subjugate first, then Phantom Rush through them for the fear. After Orion and Timewarp by minute 16, follow Subjugate with Colossal Blow when it's ready to hit whoever is caught.

support.quote: Engage with Wild Rush, slow with Highland Hurl, and let Ruthless Assault stack Hersir while your carry follows up. Once Stonewall and Raiment of Renewal are done by minute 19, stand in front and cast Unstoppable Force before you get stunned to cleanse slows.
support.issue: muddled timing: the cleanse removes debuffs already on you, so casting it 'before you get stunned' to 'cleanse slows' contradicts itself
support.rewrite: Engage with Wild Rush, slow with Highland Hurl, and let Ruthless Assault stack Hersir while your carry follows up. Once Stonewall and Raiment of Renewal are done by minute 19, stand in front and cast Unstoppable Force when you're slowed to cleanse it and gain armor for the fight.

support.quote: Riktor, Dekker and Phase win this lane, so stop starting trades against them and stay behind your carry until your jungler arrives.
support.issue: Phase is not in this lane's matchups; Narbash is the third losing matchup
support.rewrite: Riktor, Dekker and Narbash win this lane, so stop starting trades against them and stay behind your carry until your jungler arrives.

support.quote: Engage with Windsurge to slow the enemy duo, and use Cyclebreaker's damage reduction to stand in front of your carry before its stun lands. Once Stonewall and Warden's Faith are done by minute 19, switch stance with 84000 Hairs and fight from the front.
support.issue: unclear wording: 'before its stun lands' reads as an enemy stun, but the stun is Cyclebreaker's own staff throw
support.rewrite: Engage with Windsurge to slow the enemy duo, then use Cyclebreaker to take less damage while you stand in front of your carry, and land its staff throw to stun. Once Stonewall and Warden's Faith are done by minute 19, switch stance with 84000 Hairs and fight from the front.

offlane.quote: Poke with Ricochet and Bad Medicine, then back off between trades instead of trading health. After Combustion and Noxia by minute 16, hit squishy targets from behind your frontline.
offlane.issue: self-contradictory phrasing ('back off between trades instead of trading')
offlane.rewrite: Poke with Ricochet and Bad Medicine from range, then back off before they can hit you back. After Combustion and Noxia by minute 16, hit squishy targets from behind your frontline.
